description.value:
As a Bonus Action you transform into an apparition of pure magic for 1 minute, gaining the following benefits. The transformation ends early if you die, you are Incapacitated, or if you end it as a Bonus Action. Once you use this Bonus Action, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you spend 7 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

  • Arcane Wellspring. During your turn, you can trade any number of your Hit Dice for the same number of Sorcery Points (no Action required).
  • Flight. You gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover.
  • Spell Avoidance. When you're subjected to a spell or magical effect that allows you to make a Saving Throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the Saving Throw and only half damage if you fail.
